# Haru-4B soak: Mac run plan (generated by `haru_soak.py plan`, NOT run yet)

Needs Tony's OK via Jarvis first: it re-downloads the 10.54 GB model into a new test folder (~/echo-haru-soak) and runs ~2.1 h on the Mac, then deletes only that folder.

```bash
# Mac run plan (as-fast pacing: wall time ~= 0.6 x audio time at q8, measured RTF 0.604-0.609)
# Needs: >= 17 GiB free before start (model 10.54 GB = 9.8 GiB + venv ~0.6 GiB + logs/audio ~0.6 GiB, then the >= 6 GiB floor).
# Total audio 200 min -> wall ~124 min + 8 x ~25 s load/prompt ~= 2.1 h.
B=~/echo-haru-soak; mkdir -p $B/runs && cd $B
# copy in from the box: haru_soak.py, requirements.txt (the benchmark's hash-locked file), card_en.txt, card_fr.txt
export TMPDIR=$B/tmp HF_HOME=$B/hf HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PIP_CACHE_DIR=$B/pipcache; mkdir -p $TMPDIR
python3.12 -m venv venv   # 3.12.13, as in the benchmark
./venv/bin/pip install --require-hashes --no-deps -r requirements.txt   # same hash-locked set as the benchmark (mlx 0.32.4, no torch)
# model: same pinned revision + sha256 as the benchmark
curl -L --fail -o Haru-4B/model.safetensors --create-dirs https://huggingface.co/higurashi-ai/Haru-4B/resolve/8d6e83bcd3701a76fc27a764965665da1df7da78/model.safetensors
for f in config.json tokenizer.json; do curl -L --fail -o Haru-4B/$f https://huggingface.co/higurashi-ai/Haru-4B/resolve/8d6e83bcd3701a76fc27a764965665da1df7da78/$f; done
[ "$(shasum -a 256 Haru-4B/model.safetensors | cut -d' ' -f1)" = ad2c3534ef6bd88525e22e5da3ac4fb739368406bf3b1c852cbafbade647c0fa ] || exit 2
./venv/bin/python haru_soak.py selftest
./venv/bin/python haru_soak.py make-script --lang en --out script_en && ./venv/bin/python haru_soak.py make-script --lang fr --out script_fr
# A60: baseline = upstream defaults (DRY on, T 0.7, top-k 25); 10/30/60 min are checkpoints of this one run
[ $(df -k ~ | awk 'NR==2{print $4}') -gt $((6*1024*1024)) ] || exit 3; ./venv/bin/python haru_soak.py run --backend haru --model Haru-4B --quantize 8 --script script_en --system-prompt-file card_en.txt --minutes 60 --seed 0  --out runs/A60 > runs/A60.log 2>&1
# A30fr: baseline in French (Atlas/Athena/Zeus are FR+EN)
[ $(df -k ~ | awk 'NR==2{print $4}') -gt $((6*1024*1024)) ] || exit 3; ./venv/bin/python haru_soak.py run --backend haru --model Haru-4B --quantize 8 --script script_fr --system-prompt-file card_fr.txt --minutes 30 --seed 0  --out runs/A30fr > runs/A30fr.log 2>&1
# B60: all mitigations on
[ $(df -k ~ | awk 'NR==2{print $4}') -gt $((6*1024*1024)) ] || exit 3; ./venv/bin/python haru_soak.py run --backend haru --model Haru-4B --quantize 8 --script script_en --system-prompt-file card_en.txt --minutes 60 --seed 0 --kv-window 4096 --reanchor-minutes 15 --watchdog --out runs/B60 > runs/B60.log 2>&1
# C10-dryoff: ablation: is upstream DRY what keeps loops away?
[ $(df -k ~ | awk 'NR==2{print $4}') -gt $((6*1024*1024)) ] || exit 3; ./venv/bin/python haru_soak.py run --backend haru --model Haru-4B --quantize 8 --script script_en --system-prompt-file card_en.txt --minutes 10 --seed 0 --dry off --out runs/C10-dryoff > runs/C10-dryoff.log 2>&1
# C10-t05: lower temperature
[ $(df -k ~ | awk 'NR==2{print $4}') -gt $((6*1024*1024)) ] || exit 3; ./venv/bin/python haru_soak.py run --backend haru --model Haru-4B --quantize 8 --script script_en --system-prompt-file card_en.txt --minutes 10 --seed 0 --temperature 0.5 --out runs/C10-t05 > runs/C10-t05.log 2>&1
# C10-t09p09: higher temperature, nucleus
[ $(df -k ~ | awk 'NR==2{print $4}') -gt $((6*1024*1024)) ] || exit 3; ./venv/bin/python haru_soak.py run --backend haru --model Haru-4B --quantize 8 --script script_en --system-prompt-file card_en.txt --minutes 10 --seed 0 --temperature 0.9 --top-p 0.9 --out runs/C10-t09p09 > runs/C10-t09p09.log 2>&1
# C10-kv1024: KV truncation active after ~2.3 min (does quality hold?)
[ $(df -k ~ | awk 'NR==2{print $4}') -gt $((6*1024*1024)) ] || exit 3; ./venv/bin/python haru_soak.py run --backend haru --model Haru-4B --quantize 8 --script script_en --system-prompt-file card_en.txt --minutes 10 --seed 0 --kv-window 1024 --out runs/C10-kv1024 > runs/C10-kv1024.log 2>&1
# C10-dry12: stronger DRY
[ $(df -k ~ | awk 'NR==2{print $4}') -gt $((6*1024*1024)) ] || exit 3; ./venv/bin/python haru_soak.py run --backend haru --model Haru-4B --quantize 8 --script script_en --system-prompt-file card_en.txt --minutes 10 --seed 0 --dry-multiplier 1.2 --out runs/C10-dry12 > runs/C10-dry12.log 2>&1
tar czf echo-haru-soak-results.tgz runs/*/metrics.json runs/*/events.jsonl runs/*/mem.jsonl runs/*/frames.jsonl runs/*/replies.jsonl runs/*/meta.json runs/*.log
# after copying the tarball back: rm -rf ~/echo-haru-soak   (only that folder)
```


## v2 additions (2026-11-20, from Tony: deep tests + a report)
Stages are now `./run_all.sh install | smoke | faults | runs | pack`. The download is done separately by download.sh.
- smoke: selftest (59 checks, fake backend), then a 1-min real run with barge-ins and a 10 s sample.
- faults: 9 explicit error/recovery cases, each run once in its own process (~12 min): bad_frame, bad_frame_raw,
  garbage_input, truncated_input, stall (5 s), watchdog_loop, watchdog_latency, disk_low, process_kill (SIGKILL plus a clean restart).
- runs: the same 8 runs, now with `--barge-in-every 5 --sample-seconds 45 --min-free-gib 6`. The B60 budget of 150 min covers faults + runs.
- Retries are 0. runs/STATUS.tsv records every outcome, and a second invocation never re-runs a recorded id.
- pack: MAC_MANIFEST.sha256 plus the tarball. On the box, `python3 haru_soak.py summarize --results /workspace/echo/soak/results`
  writes summary.json (schema in results/SCHEMA.md), report.md, blind/ and MANIFEST.sha256.
Estimated total is ~2.4 h: smoke ~2 min + faults ~12 min + runs ~127 min.
